newsitem.title: USA: E.W. Scripps Oct revs rose to $116.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: E.W. Scripps Oct revs rose to $116.4 mln.

text.p: E.W. Scripps Co said on Wednesday that its consolidated revenues rose 24.9 percent in October to $116.4 million, compared with $93.2 million in October 1995.
The company said newspaper advertising revenues for the month were $42 million, a three percent increase, and total newspaper revenues rose 1.5 percent to $57.6 million.
Revenues from the television station group increased 19.9 percent to $34.7 million.

Political advertising in October, the month before the election for president and other national offices, totaled $9 million compared with $800,000 in the same month in the prior year. Year-to-date political advertising was $16.1 million through October 1996 compared with $1.6 million through October 1995.
